rules.name: CREATE_PRIMARY_BUTTON_LEFT
rules.constraint: primary .section-add-button left of .item-view-switch; create ids excluded from switch modes

rules.name: URL_SYNC
rules.constraint: MUST be executed on every SectionViewToolbar onChange callback

rules.name: NO_UNICODE_EMOJI_CONTROLS
rules.constraint: Control icons MUST use <Icon name='...' /> or <svg> rather than emoji symbols

rules.name: GLOBAL_ITEM_VIEW_DELEGATION
rules.constraint: Section toolbars delegate standard item view modes to global view selector; no duplicate inline buttons

rules.name: WORKSPACE_RAIL_ORGANIZATION_NAV
rules.constraint: On viewport=pc the organization switcher lives uncollapsed in the primary workspace rail with '+ Nowa organizacja…'; compact viewports use the drawer; no navbar brand-row duplicate

rules.name: URL_CHROME_VS_SECTION
rules.constraint: view= is section/create mode only; presentation is item_view=; tenant is organization=; org= is a filter

rules.name: VIEWPORT_PRESET_DEFAULTS
rules.constraint: tablet and mobile default item_view=cards; pc defaults to table; 375px mobile has no horizontal overflow and hides the rail

rules.name: CONTEXTUAL_WORK_AND_GROUP_OVERVIEW
rules.constraint: projects/tasks/calendar are contextual chat actions; rail summary opens group overview; support is not a registry leaf

rules.name: SITE_FOOTER
rules.constraint: One site footer on public and app chrome; do not inject a second footer into #root
